provenance.method: Original ten categories with editorial example answers, not an exhaustive accepted-answer key. The mistaken borsa example is replaced with għassa; pronunciation is not automatically graded.

question.english: Give three words beginning with MU.

answer.english: music; museum; ram. These are examples, not the only possible answers.

question.english: Give three words beginning with TI.

answer.english: boy; girl; window. Other valid words also work.

question.english: Name three things found by the sea.

answer.english: sand; waves; rocks. Compare the meanings of your own examples.

question.english: Name three things found in the kitchen.

answer.english: oven; fridge; spoon. Other kitchen objects also work.

question.english: Give three words ending in AN.

answer.english: sultan; Italian (masculine); American (masculine). Other valid words also work.

question.english: Give three words ending in SA.

answer.english: female cat; dress; watch / guard duty. Borża means bag, but does not end in SA.

question.english: Give three words that rhyme with ktieb (book).

answer.english: door; dogs; friends. Compare pronunciation, not just written endings; ask a speaker or teacher about other rhyme candidates.
bread; cheese; rice. Other food words also work.
water; coffee; juice. Other drink words also work.

question.english: Name three things that are red.

answer.english: tomatoes; strawberries; a cherry, in their usual red varieties. Check the actual colour of your own examples.
